description: One query inside a loop of a `!` function, against a real SQLite: fill(6) writes three rows then fails (all three rolled back), fill(1) writes three and succeeds — 3 rows persist (6 without the envelope).
rationale: §8.9.2 F10: "A query is counted once per time it is reached: one reached through two calls … counts twice, as one inside a loop does." Ruling user-voice-scrml.md S473 "#1690 review" item 1: "Reach multiplicity counts".
